rules.statement: The court will not grant a declaration of title where the media in question are different from those on which the plaintiff previously based his title.
rules.supporting_quote: (1) The Media on which the plaintiff now seeks a declaration of title are different from. the media on which he, based his title in the earlier case: The cause of action is different. (2) Prescriptive title has to be re-considered on the basis of the new character in which the plaintiff figures in the second action. Plaintiff would have passing to him whatever title by prescription which Jefferjee had and this differs from the prescriptive title he claimed in the earlier case
